argv:
set -e
mkdir -p "$HOME/bin" "$HOME/queue" "$HOME/queue/done" "$HOME/logs"
cat > "$HOME/bin/run-queue.sh" <<'RUNNER'
#!/bin/bash
# ontrack-saas-build runner: one queued job per minute, durable across worker timeouts
Q="$HOME/queue"
for f in "$Q"/*.sh; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || exit 0
  base=$(basename "$f" .sh)
  mv "$f" "$Q/running-$base.sh"
  /bin/bash "$Q/running-$base.sh" > "$HOME/logs/$base.log" 2>&1
  echo "exit=$?" > "$HOME/logs/$base.status"
  mv "$Q/running-$base.sh" "$Q/done/$base.sh"
  exit 0
done
exit 0
RUNNER
chmod 700 "$HOME/bin/run-queue.sh"
cat > "$HOME/queue/bootstrap-laravel.sh" <<'BUILD'
#!/bin/bash
PHP=/opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php
C="$HOME/bin/composer.phar"
set -x
rm -rf "$HOME/saas-build"
$PHP $C create-project laravel/laravel "$HOME/saas-build" --no-interaction --prefer-dist --no-scripts
test -f "$HOME/saas-build/artisan" || exit 20
cp -a "$HOME/saas-build/." "$HOME/public_html/saas/"
cd "$HOME/public_html/saas"
cp -f .env.example .env
sed -i 's/^SESSION_DRIVER=.*/SESSION_DRIVER=file/' .env
sed -i 's/^APP_ENV=.*/APP_ENV=production/' .env
sed -i 's/^APP_DEBUG=.*/APP_DEBUG=false/' .env
$PHP artisan key:generate --force
$PHP artisan migrate --force
$PHP artisan --version
echo LARAVEL_READY
BUILD
chmod 700 "$HOME/queue/bootstrap-laravel.sh"
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'ontrack-saas-build'; echo '* * * * * /bin/bash /home/appontrack/bin/run-queue.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 # ontrack-saas-build') | crontab -
crontab -l | tail -3
echo "=QUEUED="; ls -l "$HOME/queue"
echo "=DONE="
